rooms.name: Cellar Stairwell
rooms.description: The stair bottoms out in a low concrete landing, pipes sweating overhead, a single bare conduit running toward a corridor.

rooms.name: Utility Corridor
rooms.description: A low underground corridor of sweating pipes and conduit runs toward a steel door stenciled TANK ACCESS — AUTHORIZED ONLY. The fuel smell here is thick enough to taste.
dressing: Pipes sweat cold condensation overhead
A stenciled warning about open flames peels off the wall
The fuel smell is thick enough to taste

rooms.name: Tank Inspection Room
rooms.description: A vaulted concrete room built over the station's buried tanks, its far wall a bank of brass dip-tubes, gauge wheels, and manual valves. Every needle rests high, and the whole room hums faintly with held fuel.
dressing: Every gauge needle rests reassuringly high
Brass fittings gleam where decades of hands have polished them
The room hums faintly with the pressure of held fuel

hiddenDressing.text: One valve wheel is wrapped in fresh electrical tape, sealing a hairline seep — the only repair in the room, and very recent.

rooms.name: Forecourt
dressing: Buzzing pink neon washes everything in a sickly glow
Car doors hang open on cold engines
A steady rattling thud carries from the far pump island
Wind pushes a plastic bag in slow circles

hiddenDressing.text: A single set of bare footprints in dried blood leads from the diner door to pump 6, then stops.

rooms.name: Parking Lot
rooms.description: Rows of dust-filmed cars sit nose-in along the lot, some with luggage still strapped to their roofs. The motel's VACANCY sign stutters red above the office next door.
dressing: Luggage spills from one open trunk
A child's stuffed animal lies face-down in a parking stripe
The VACANCY sign flickers in an irregular stutter

rooms.name: Pump Island
rooms.description: Five pumps stand under a humming canopy, hoses coiled like sleeping snakes, the air thick with the sweet reek of spilled gasoline. The sixth pump, at the far end, is boxed in by a glass kiosk that shudders with every blow from inside.
dressing: Heavy gasoline stink stings the eyes
Price numbers on the big sign have slid loose and hang crooked
The hammering from pump 6 is loud here, glass buzzing in its frame

hiddenDressing.text: Deep parallel gouges score the kiosk's outside door frame, as if something tried to keep it shut from out here.

rooms.name: Pump 6 Kiosk
rooms.description: The little glass payment kiosk at pump 6 is smeared from the inside with blood and condensation, its cramped floor littered with broken shelf brackets. Every few seconds the whole structure jumps with a blow from something far too strong for the room it's in.
dressing: Cracks web across the kiosk glass, starred at each impact point
The pump's digital display still reads the last sale: $11.20
The smell of raw fuel seeps from a stressed hose coupling

hiddenDressing.text: A handwritten note taped inside the register reads: 'Tillis locked himself in with it. Do NOT open. Tanks still good. Tell someone.'

rooms.name: Convenience Store
rooms.description: Fluorescent tubes flicker over aisles of snacks and motor oil, one shelf toppled and spilling candy across the curling linoleum. The drinks cooler hums behind smeared glass, its light the steadiest in the building.
dressing: The drinks cooler hums, its light steady and cold
A toppled shelf spills candy bars into the aisle
Hanging ceiling signs sway gently though no air moves

hiddenDressing.text: Dozens of scratch marks cover the inside of the front door's push bar.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.description: A short service hallway links the store, diner, and garage, its walls lined with faded safety posters and a dead wall clock stopped at 3:12. Doors stand at either end and mid-way, all slightly ajar.
dressing: The wall clock reads 3:12, second hand twitching in place
A mop bucket has dried into a grey scum ring
One fluorescent tube strobes erratically overhead

rooms.name: Stockroom
rooms.description: Tall metal shelves crowd this dim stockroom, stacked with cases of oil, paper goods, and soda syrup boxes. A steel door in the corner stands open on a descending staircase breathing cold, fuel-tinged air.
dressing: Cardboard cases are stacked in leaning towers
Cold air seeps up from the open cellar door
A clipboard of inventory sheets lies trampled on the floor

hiddenDressing.text: A scrawl in marker on the cellar door frame reads 'count twice, sign once — D.T.'

rooms.name: Store Office
rooms.description: A cramped office barely fits a desk, a swivel chair, and a wall of shift schedules pinned with colored tacks. The window blinds are drawn tight against the forecourt lights.
dressing: Shift schedules cover the wall in a grid of colored tacks
A mug on the desk has dried into a brown ring
The blinds rattle faintly against the window glass

hiddenDressing.text: The last page of the shift ledger has a single line underlined three times: 'Tillis sleeping in kiosk — DO NOT WAKE.'

rooms.name: Diner Dining Room
rooms.description: Red vinyl booths line the windows under chrome trim still gleaming in the neon spill, and milkshakes sit curdling on the counter. The jukebox in the corner plays the same four bars of the Everly Brothers, catches, and starts again.
dressing: The jukebox loops the same four bars, skipping each time
Milkshakes on the counter have separated into grey curds
Pie slices still sit under a glass dome, untouched
Chrome trim gleams incongruously clean

hiddenDressing.text: Under a napkin dispenser, someone has written in ketchup: 'it counts the pumps'.

rooms.name: Diner Kitchen
rooms.description: A narrow galley kitchen of grease-yellowed steel, the flat-top still faintly warm, its pilot light a blue bead in the gloom. A swing door leads back to the dining room and a heavy steel door seals the walk-in freezer.
dressing: The flat-top's pilot light burns a steady blue bead
A order wheel still holds three yellowed tickets
Something metallic drips slowly into the floor drain

rooms.name: Walk-in Freezer
rooms.description: The walk-in's compressor died days ago, leaving a damp, meat-smelling cold. Wire shelves hold frost-melted boxes, and something stands very still in the far corner, rimed white.
dressing: The compressor is dead; the cold is going damp
Melted frost pools under the wire shelving
A thawed box of patties sags in its own cardboard

rooms.name: Restroom
rooms.description: A single-occupancy restroom tiled in cracked white hex, the mirror shattered into the sink. The hand dryer hangs off the wall by its wiring.
dressing: Mirror shards fill the sink basin
The faucet drips in a slow, even count
A dark streak runs from the door to the floor drain

hiddenDressing.text: Scratched into the stall-side of the door: 'DON'T OPEN THE KIOSK'.

rooms.name: Garage Bay
rooms.description: A two-lift service bay smelling of oil and old rubber, one lift holding a pickup truck at chest height on a single creaking jack stand. Toolboards line the walls, most hooks empty, their contents scattered.
dressing: Old oil stains bloom black across the dirt floor
A wall calendar is still turned to the wrong month
The jack stand under the truck ticks softly as it settles

rooms.name: Parts Storage
rooms.description: A caged alcove off the garage bay, shelves dense with filters, belts, and boxed brake pads. Dust lies undisturbed on everything except one recently cleared shelf.
dressing: A single shelf has been swept clear in the dust
Fan belts hang in loops like cured meat
The cage gate's padlock hangs open on its hasp

rooms.name: Motel Office
rooms.description: The motel office is a narrow counter, a key rack, and — improbably — a full shortwave radio rig wired into the wall, its tape reel still turning on a loop. A figure sits slumped over the desk, long past moving.
dressing: The tape reel turns endlessly on its loop
A figure sits slumped over the radio desk, long still
Room keys hang untouched on their numbered hooks
Static hisses under the recorded voice's cracks

hiddenDressing.text: The log's final entry, in a shaking hand: 'It hears the pumps. Keep it fed or it breaks the lines. God forgive me.'

rooms.name: Stairwell to Cellar
rooms.description: A narrow concrete stair descends into the dark, the air rising from below cold and dense with the smell of diesel.

entities.name: Fuel Manifest
contents: a dipped-gauge log showing both underground tanks near full
a stamped delivery invoice dated last week
a set of tank valve tags

statBlock.name: Shuffling Traveler
statBlock.appearance: A gaunt corpse in a rumpled suit jacket, one arm missing below the elbow, still wearing a conference lanyard.

statBlock.name: Shuffling Teenager
statBlock.appearance: A skinny dead teenager in a letterman jacket, skin grey-green, headphones fused into one ear by dried blood.

statBlock.name: Pump Attendant Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A heavyset dead attendant in a grease-stained work shirt, a squeegee still clutched in one swollen hand.

statBlock.name: Pump Attendant Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A lank-haired corpse in a company windbreaker, throat torn open, name patch reading only 'R…'.

statBlock.name: Shuffling Customer
statBlock.appearance: A dead woman in a rain slicker, a fuel nozzle tangled around one ankle, face grey and waxy.

entities.name: A wide rainbow-sheened puddle of gasoline spreading from a split hose, a frayed extension cable sparking at its edge

statBlock.name: The Pump Six Attendant
statBlock.appearance: A massively swollen corpse in a splitting attendant uniform, skin the grey-blue of old bruises, one arm corded with unnatural muscle and fused around a heavy pipe wrench. Fuel stains soak its chest, and a laminated name tag reads 'D. TILLIS — MANAGER'.

statBlock.name: Store Clerk Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A dead clerk in a red smock over a band t-shirt, cheek torn to the teeth, a pricing gun dangling from a wrist lanyard.

statBlock.name: Shuffling Shopper
statBlock.appearance: A grey-faced corpse in a trucker cap and denim jacket, still clutching a torn bag of ice melt.

statBlock.name: Waitress Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A dead waitress in a pink uniform and white apron, orthopedic shoes caked with blood, an order pad still tucked in her waistband.

statBlock.name: Booth Customer Zombie
statBlock.appearance: An elderly corpse in a cardigan, half-risen from a booth posture, spectacles hanging from one ear.

statBlock.name: Trucker Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A broad dead man in a mesh cap and sleeveless shirt, forearms tattooed, face cratered with bite marks.

statBlock.name: Cook Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A hulking dead cook in a spattered white apron and paper hat, one hand wrapped in a blood-soaked towel, the other gripping a cleaver it no longer knows how to use.

statBlock.name: Frozen Attendant
statBlock.appearance: A frost-rimed corpse in a station attendant jacket, skin split and white at the knuckles, icicles in its hair, moving with stiff cracking joints.

entities.name: The freezer's broken interior latch and a heavy hydraulic closer hissing on the steel door

statBlock.name: Mechanic Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A dead mechanic in oil-blackened coveralls, scalp partly torn away, a rag stiff with gore in the chest pocket.

statBlock.name: Mechanic Zombie
statBlock.appearance: A wiry corpse in a garage uniform shirt buttoned wrong, dragging a creeper board tangled around one leg.

entities.name: Tool Locker
contents: a socket set in a steel case

entities.name: A pickup truck balanced on a single creaking jack stand, its wheels directly over the bay door track
Parts Shelf
contents: a box of six road flares

entities.name: Radio Logbook
contents: a handwritten broadcast log ending three days ago
a pencilled sketch of the underground tank layout

entities.name: Cellar Key
contents: a brass padlock key on a ring, tagged CELLAR

questChain.name: The Problem at Pump 6
questChain.description:
- Cross the forecourt through the shuffling ex-staff to reach the rattling kiosk at pump 6
- Identify what is hammering on the glass from inside and stop it before it ruptures the fuel lines and sends the whole station up
- Confirm the underground tanks are intact and claimable, as the radio voice promised

questChain.name: The Voice on the Radio
questChain.description:
- Follow the looped broadcast's hiss to its source in the motel office next door
- Search the radio desk for who recorded the warning and what they knew about the tanks

questChain.name: Full Tanks Below
questChain.description:
- Use the broadcaster's cellar key to open the tank access door below the stockroom
- Confirm by the gauge log in the inspection room that the underground tanks are intact and full

questChain.name: Roll Out
questChain.description:
- Get the party's vehicle filled from the claimed tanks and load whatever supplies were scavenged
- Leave the station before the noise of the fight draws whatever else is out on the highway
